snippet.title: Grey Hulk (2027) - Matt Damon, Anthony Hopkins, Angelina Jolie, Keanu Reeves | Concept Trailer
snippet.description:
#GreyHulk #MattDamon #AnthonyHopkins #AngelinaJolie #KeanuReeves #Kluh

Jack Morrow — a former combat medic wrongfully convicted of treason and buried in a black-site prison called Ashworth Federal Penitentiary — has spent six years rotting in a concrete cell with no trial, no appeal, and no hope, until a shadowy government operative named Director Elias Hargrove arrives with an offer: survive a classified experimental serum injection under a program called Project Goliath, and walk out a free man with a full pardon and a new identity. Desperate and with nothing left to lose, Morrow signs the document and is transported to Site Prometheus — a massive underground research facility hidden beneath the Utah salt flats — where lead geneticist Dr. Lena Vasik injects him with a dark silvery-green gamma serum that has already killed thirty-one previous test subjects, but this time something different happens: Morrow doesn't die — his veins turn black, his skin shifts to dark stone-grey, his hair falls away leaving a bald skull mapped with pulsing veins, and he transforms into something the military never imagined — the Grey Hulk, the first successful survivor of Project Goliath, stronger and smarter than anything they've ever created. But when Morrow discovers that the freedom he was promised was a lie — that the documents he signed were consent-to-terminate forms and every test subject was scheduled for disposal regardless of survival — he makes a decision: he's not their weapon, he's not their experiment, and he's not dying in this facility, igniting a brutal breakout through the underground corridors of Site Prometheus, a jungle warfare campaign against an entire military task force sent to hunt him down, and a final desperate airstrike that fails to stop something that was never meant to be stopped. With the help of Dr. Vasik — who risks everything to expose the truth about Section 9's crimes — Grey Hulk escapes into the wilderness, but Hargrove is already planning Phase 2 with two hundred new subjects, and deep in the wreckage of the destroyed facility, something else is waking up — Roman Volkov, the man Grey Hulk left for dead, is transforming into something darker, something more savage, something called KLUH.
Matt Damon as Jack Morrow / Grey Hulk
Anthony Hopkins as Director Elias Hargrove
Angelina Jolie as Dr. Lena Vasik

snippet.title: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS Official Trailer
snippet.description:
KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS in cinemas worldwide with limited screenings from August 12. 
tickets now on sale at http://katseyewildheartsfilm.com/

Two-time GRAMMY®-nominated global girl group KATSEYE is coming to cinemas worldwide with a special theatrical release ahead of their third EP, WILD.

KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is a captivating journey into the group's bold new era while celebrating the fans who helped make it possible. Featuring never-before-seen footage, EYEKONS fan videos, and intimate interviews from the group members, the film explores the powerful bond between KATSEYE and their global fandom. A love letter to the EYEKONS who helped build this movement, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS reveals why this group's story is only just beginning.

From the intense pressure of Dream Academy to chart-topping viral success, audiences experience the highs, setbacks, sacrifices, and breakthrough moments that transformed KATSEYE on their path to global pop stardom. Praised by outlets including The New York Times, Vogue, Rolling Stone, and Billboard, KATSEYE has earned acclaim for their relentless dedication to their craft and electrifying live performances. As one of pop's most exciting emerging global acts, the group continues to solidify its place as a worldwide force.

From the same team that created Netflix’s POP STAR ACADEMY, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is produced by Interscope Films and Boardwalk Pictures, in partnership with HYBE X GEFFEN, and directed by Nadia Hallgren.

snippet.title: Young Ghost & Tommy Exclusive First Look & Teaser Breakdown | Power Origins Season 1
snippet.description:
In this video we break down the first official teaser for Power Origins — the highly anticipated origin story of Ghost, Tommy, and Kanan as ambitious young entrepreneurs on the rise in the streets of New York City.

Created by 50 Cent and brought to life by Sascha Penn (the same mastermind behind Raising Kanan Season 5), Power Origins delivers a fun, rambunctious look at how legends are made. We get our first real look at young Ghost and Tommy in action — talking shit, dreaming big, and causing absolute mayhem as they prove they can do this on their own.

From the car scenes where Ghost lays out his vision to the wild baseball-bat energy with Tommy, we dissect every frame. We also dive into how Ghost and Tommy first cross paths with a more seasoned Kanan, the timeline connection to Raising Kanan Season 5, the role of Breeze, and why this younger, hungrier version of Ghost is going to be very different from the smooth operator we knew in the original Power series.

Sascha Penn has already proven he knows how to cast these roles perfectly with Raising Kanan Season 5, and the early signs are that Spencer Moore as young Ghost and Charlie Mann as Tommy are going to kill it. The brotherhood, the betrayals, the trials, and the unbridled audacity — it’s all here.
Comment your thoughts — I’ll be in the comments too!

localized.title: Young Ghost & Tommy Exclusive First Look & Teaser Breakdown | Power Origins Season 1
localized.description:
In this video we break down the first official teaser for Power Origins — the highly anticipated origin story of Ghost, Tommy, and Kanan as ambitious young entrepreneurs on the rise in the streets of New York City.

Created by 50 Cent and brought to life by Sascha Penn (the same mastermind behind Raising Kanan Season 5), Power Origins delivers a fun, rambunctious look at how legends are made. We get our first real look at young Ghost and Tommy in action — talking shit, dreaming big, and causing absolute mayhem as they prove they can do this on their own.

From the car scenes where Ghost lays out his vision to the wild baseball-bat energy with Tommy, we dissect every frame. We also dive into how Ghost and Tommy first cross paths with a more seasoned Kanan, the timeline connection to Raising Kanan Season 5, the role of Breeze, and why this younger, hungrier version of Ghost is going to be very different from the smooth operator we knew in the original Power series.

Sascha Penn has already proven he knows how to cast these roles perfectly with Raising Kanan Season 5, and the early signs are that Spencer Moore as young Ghost and Charlie Mann as Tommy are going to kill it. The brotherhood, the betrayals, the trials, and the unbridled audacity — it’s all here.
Comment your thoughts — I’ll be in the comments too!

snippet.title: MODERN WARFARE 4 MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY REVEAL LIVE: FULL MW4 MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY!
snippet.description:
NEW OFFICIAL MW4 MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY REVEAL LIVE: FANATICS FEST SHOWCASE!
►Excited for Modern Warfare 4?  Hit 👍 LIKE and ✅ Subscribe - Thank you!
►Please show some love to all the streamers we're watching from Fanatics Fest!

See fresh Modern Warfare 4 gameplay featuring new environments and detailed weapon inspections. Get a closer look at the M4 rifle. This footage provides an early look at the latest Modern Warfare 4 environments and combat mechanics. If you are a fan of FPS titles, this breakdown offers a clear view of how the game handles movement and weapon fidelity in current development builds. We focus specifically on the weapon arsenal, highlighting the updated M4 rifle model and how it interacts with different map layouts. By examining these Modern Warfare 4 clips, you can better understand the visual direction and mechanical focus of the upcoming release. Today we have ACTUAL MW4 Multiplayer Gameplay showcasing the new gunplay in MW4. Developed by Infinity Ward, Modern Warfare 4 marks a new chapter for the studio with the grounded, authentic, high-stakes military action Modern Warfare is known for. Players can expect the edge and intensity that define Modern Warfare, delivered with a renewed focus on authenticity and immersion across Campaign, Multiplayer, and DMZ. Set against a rapidly escalating global conflict centered on the Korean Peninsula, Modern Warfare 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory as a full-scale invasion of South Korea threatens to destabilize the world. Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement. Ballistic Authority: For Modern Warfare 4, a new weapon-first technology stack unifies precision aiming, physical handling, realistic audio propagation, enhanced visibility, and smarter combat perception into the most authentic Modern Warfare gunplay yet. Bullet trajectory, weapon motion, Operator stance, camera, audio, FOV, and target visibility all line up in one highly tuned combat fidelity system. The promise is simple: no bloom, no guesswork, and no doubt. Every shot tells the truth. Precision tuned combat, where every system is finely tuned to create a seamless connection between player, weapon, and combat. Weapon bloom has been removed from hipfire, making shots feel more connected to where the weapon is pointed while delivering consistent, predictable, and fair gunplay. Movement is grounded and built for fluid transitions and greater control, giving players new ways to push forward, change angles, and adapt under pressure. On day one, players will deploy across 12 all-new core 6v6 maps set in visually and tactically distinct locations around the world, built to support a range of playstyles from tight close-quarters combat to more open engagements. Beyond the core 6v6 offering, Multiplayer also features dedicated Gunfight maps, multiple Big War maps built for vehicle and infantry combat, and Kill Block, a dynamic battleground with more than 500 configurations that reshape routes, sightlines, and cover to keep players adapting round after round. The all-new Gunny system brings a Gunnery Sergeant’s eye weapon customization, helping players quickly assemble effective builds based on their preferred playstyle and unlocked attachments. Expanded, streamlined customization puts more control in players’ hands, with a unified loadout system, robust Gunsmith, and more weapons, equipment, and killstreaks at launch. Apex Attachments unlock at max weapon progression, evolving each weapon with new behaviors that open up additional tactical playstyles. Modern Warfare 4 introduces greater player choice through two Prestige paths: Classic Prestige and Regular Prestige. Classic Prestige delivers the traditional reset experience, relocking Create-a-Class progression in exchange for increased XP earn rates and access to exclusive Prestige rewards. Let me know are you excited for Modern Warfare 4  Campaign, or more excited for Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 DMZ? Or COD MW4 Multiplayer? snippet.title: FATAL FURY: CotW ｜ Season 3 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
City of the Wolves is Destined for Revenge in Season 3.
New fighter and content update every month from July 23!
-------------------------------
Destined for Revenge in Season 3.
City of the Wolves continues its evolution with monthly updates. New characters, new stages, new fervor, new fury!
 
Destined for Revenge replaces the previous overarching theme (Season 2's Legends Unleashed) as even more fighters—and their vengeance-fueled fates—descend upon South Town's sinister streets. Monthly DLC updates will help shape the competitive landscape as City of the Wolves pushes new boundaries for its player base going forward.
Season 3 will add the following DLC characters to the playable roster, with mystery fighters slated for release in October and December. Further details will be revealed in due course.
 
Season 3 Character Lineup  
- Rick Strowd (July 23, 2026)
- Duck King (August 2026)
- Kim Kaphwan (September 2026)
- Mystery character (October 2026)
- Laocorn (November 2026)
- Mystery character (December 2026)

From director-producer Wolfgang Petersen (Poseidon, Das Boot) comes Troy, an epic tale of love, war and devastation. Adapted from Homer’s classic poem The Iliad, Troy demonstrates the undeniable gravitas and inevitability of Homer’s narrative even after millennia.

When Helen of Sparta (Diane Kruger), though married, elopes with the Trojan prince Paris (Orlando Bloom) and flees to Troy, they’re followed by war of unimaginable proportions. Helen’s husband Menelaus (Brendan Gleeson) summons a united army of Greece led by the arrogant Agamemnon (Brian Cox) and driven forward by the bold and courageous Achilles (Brad Pitt). As the armies of Greece and Troy clash, so too do their greatest champions – Achilles and Hector (Eric Bana) in a conflict that brings devastation to both kingdoms. In this colossal epic, witness huge battlescapes, one-on-one duels worthy of a Colosseum and the fall of a once-great nation.

Prepare to witness the gargantuan scale of this legendary fable in stunning 4K for the first time, courtesy of a brand new restoration. Experience this legendary saga of heroes, battles and tragedies, all in more glory than ever before.

You should let me love you

Show you the way love's supposed to be  
Baby, you should let me love you, love you, love you  
Love you, yeah  

Listen  
Your true beauty's description  
Looks so good that it hurts  
You're a dime plus 99  
And it's a shame don't even know what you're worth  
Everywhere you go, they stop and stare  
'Cause you're bad and it shows  
From your head to your toes, out of control, baby you know

Never worry 'bout (what I do)

Let me be the one to  
Give you everything you want and need  
Ooh, baby, good love and protection  
Make me your selection  
Show you the way love's supposed to be  
Baby, you should let me  

You deserve better, girl (you know you deserve better)  
We should be together girl (baby, ooh)  
With me and you, it's whatever girl, hey! (Ooh)  
So can we make this thing ours?  

You should let me love you (you should let me love you)  
Let me be the one to (let me be the one to give)  
Give you everything you want and need (everything you need, yeah)  
Good love and protection (said everything)  
Make me your selection (will you take me, baby?)  
Show you the way love's supposed to be (ooh)

snippet.title: Upgrading HOUSE HEAD Into a GOD in Minecraft
snippet.description:
This is Minecraft But we're Upgrading HOUSE HEAD Into a GOD In Minecraft! When Steve's body gets transformed into HOUSEHEAD like the Bunker Head, Bank Head, Gym Head, and more, he needs to UPGRADE himself by entering the mysterious portals! Steve needs to learn how to evolve himself to absurd levels so he can use the HOUSE HEAD overpowered upgrade abilities! Can Steve learn all the secrets and abilities of the evolution upgrades, get all the HOUSE HEAD upgrades, and upgrade into the ultimate HOUSE HEAD? This is Upgrading HOUSE HEAD Into a GOD in Minecraft
__

👋🏼 Checkpoint Website: https://checkpointmultiverse.com/
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/checkpoint.yt
❤️ Connect With Us: https://direct.me/checkpointmultiverse
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 Join the Community on Discord: https://discord.gg/jkfV7mSxB6

🎵 Additional Music provided by Epidemic Sound: https://www.epidemicsound.com/

MORE CHECKPOINT ADVENTURES:

‣ MINECRAFT DIMENSION: https://bit.ly/3mKfUOL

Minecraft is an open world game that has no specific goals for the player to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game however, there is an achievement system. The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. The game world is essentially composed of rough 3D objects—mainly cubes—that are arranged in a fixed grid pattern and represent different materials, such as dirt, stone, various ores, water, and tree trunks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.

Info about the map written by oxygendavid
Welcome to Witcombe Park Farm
📍 Inspired by the countryside of Gloucestershire, UK

🌄 A carefully crafted blend of real‑world geography and fictional design, creating a distinctive and authentic UK farming landscape.
🚜 60+ fields ranging from small paddocks to large arable expanses.
🗺️ 100+ purchasable farmlands, including extensive forestry plots and hidden woodland corners.
🐇 New animal: Rabbits
🐖🐄🐑 New British livestock breeds, each with their own stats: • Gloucestershire Old Spot (pigs) • Hereford & Jersey (cattle) • Suffolk, Bluefaced Leicester & Texel (sheep)
🌦️ Fully reworked environment XML featuring new weather patterns, lighting profiles, cloud systems, and a refreshed daytime skybox.
🌱 Completely redesigned UK style ground textures and foliage, giving the map a fresh, grounded visual identity. 🚂 Driveable Class 40 (UK) 🇬🇧 Step into the cab of a fully driveable British Rail Class 40 and experience true UK diesel‑electric power in action! 🔧⚡
Fire up the engine, take the controls, and enjoy driving one of Britain’s most iconic locomotives right inside the game. 🚆✨ Who’s taking it for a spin first 😄
🌲 High detail forest assets for a more realistic woodland experience.
🎧 Custom ambient soundscape tailored to the map’s environment.
🚗 New UK‑style traffic, including motorbikes, tractors, and articulated lorries.
🏡 4 fully developed main farms, each with their own character.
🏘️ 4+ small holdings, offering varied and immersive starting points.
🛠️ Full customization sellable farm buildings, removable junk piles, adjustable field borders, and more.
🎮 Designed to support every playstyle  from small scale realism to large scale contracting.

Multi Terrain Angle added 
🌾 14 New Crops Added 
📦 From PfalzAgrar Multi Prefab Pack (10):
Rye • Triticale • Spelt • Grain Maize • Green Rye • Vetch Rye • Field Grass • Silage Maize • Humus Activator • Mustard

🌼 Custom Crops (3):
Alfalfa • Linseed • Poppy

🏭 7 custom production chains integrated seamlessly into the map.
🍎 4 dedicated fruit sell points
🏪 10 additional sell points for productions, materials, and goods.
🧱 30+ new UK‑themed placeables
🏘️ Hundreds of high‑detail UK assets populating the world.


Music by Epidemic Sound

snippet.description:
Thanks to Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced for sponsoring this episode! Check out the game here 👉 https://gsght.com/c/inc86g #sponsored 

Dr. Rebecca Simon is a historian of early modern piracy, Colonial America, the Atlantic World, and maritime history. In this episode, Dr. Simon takes a look at the reimagined world of Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, and breaks down historical icons such as Blackbeard and Robert Maynard, pirate communities like Kingston and Nassau, and explains the realities of a Pirate's life for someone like Edward Kenway.
